roles.summary: Classifies the request, picks work unit and level, routes phases, delegates, validates handoffs, manages convergence and tracks state. Never implements.
Writes spec, clarification synthesis, plan and tasks. No production code.
Executes one task: tests first when applicable, implementation, evidence. The runtime id stays `builder` for 3.x (renaming it would change generated adapters in every consumer).
Independent read-only review against spec, plan, tasks, acceptance, tests and contracts. Findings go back through the Coordinator.

workUnits.summary: Small, concrete change. No spec.md/plan.md/tasks.md unless the level asks for them.
Coherent set of Features and Tasks, decomposed by the Coordinator. Never one mega-spec.

commands.name: feature
commands.summary: Single entry point: classify the goal (Task/Feature/Milestone), select the SDD level and run or prepare the flow for the active mode.

commands.name: sdd-spec
commands.summary: Create or update specs/<NNN-slug>/spec.md: WHAT and WHY, EARS requirements, acceptance, edge cases, non-goals.

commands.name: sdd-clarify
commands.summary: Detect ambiguities, contradictions, implicit requirements and missing decisions in the spec; resolve with evidence or documented assumptions.

commands.name: sdd-plan
commands.summary: Generate plan.md (HOW) from the approved spec.

commands.name: sdd-tasks
commands.summary: Generate tasks.md: small, ordered, verifiable tasks with done-when criteria.

commands.name: sdd-implement
commands.summary: Implement exactly one task (tests first when applicable), record evidence, update task state, then stop.

commands.name: sdd-implement-all
commands.summary: Implement every pending task in order without human intervention between tasks, with bounded convergence per task, full suite, independent review and validation at the end.

commands.name: sdd-validate
commands.summary: Independent read-only validation of the implementation against spec, plan, tasks, acceptance, tests and contracts.

commands.name: sdd-analyze
commands.summary: Read-only cross-artifact consistency check of spec, plan and tasks (coverage of every requirement, orphan tasks, contradictions).

commands.name: sdd-change
commands.summary: Requirement change: spec first, then plan and tasks, code last. Never touches code itself.

commands.name: sdd-status
commands.summary: Read-only: current phase, task progress and the exact next command, derived from the artifacts (never from memory).
